title: Seetha's taunting reply to Rama
introduction: Seetha gives a taunting reply to Rama, saying that why she was not abandoned by the latter, even at the time when Hanuma came to see her in Lanka. Then, Seetha requests Lakshmana to prepare a pile of fire for her to enter. When Lakshmana prepares a pyre, Seetha prays the fire-god and enters into it, in order toprove her conjugal fidelity.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे षोडशाधिकशततमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 116th chapter in Yuddha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्ता तु वैदेही परुषं लोमहर्षणम् |
राघवेण सरोषेण भृशं प्रव्यथिताभवत्
verses.iast:
evamuktA tu vaidehI paruṣaṃ lomaharṣaṇam |
rAghaveṇa saroṣeṇa bhṛśaṃ pravyathitAbhavat
verses.translation: Hearing the harsh words with indignation, spoken by Rama, which caused her hair to stand on end, Seetha became very much perturbed.

glosses.meaning: which caused her hair to stand on end

verses.devanagari:
सा तदश्रुतपूर्वं हि जने महति मैथिली |
श्रुत्वा भर्तृवचो रूक्षं लज्जया व्रीडिताभवत्
verses.iast:
sA tadaśrutapUrvaṃ hi jane mahati maithilI |
śrutvA bhartṛvaco rUkṣaṃ lajjayA vrIḍitAbhavat
verses.translation: Hearing the terrific words of her husband, which were never actually heard by her before, amidst a large gathering of people, Seetha stood bent low with shame.

glosses.meaning: which were never heard by her before
amidst a large gathering of people

verses.devanagari:
प्रविशन्तीव गात्राणि स्वान्येव जनकात्मजा |
वाक्षल्यैस्तैः सशल्येव भृशमश्रूण्यवर्तयत्
verses.iast:
praviśantIva gAtrAṇi svAnyeva janakAtmajA |
vAkśalyaistaiḥ saśalyeva bhṛśamaśrUṇyavartayat
verses.translation: As though her own limbs were pierced by those words, which were arrow-like with pointed splinters, Seetha shed profuse tears.

verses.devanagari:
ततो बाष्पपरिक्लिष्टं प्रमार्जन्ती स्वमाननम् |
शनैर्गद्गदया वाचा भर्तारमिदमब्रवीत्
verses.iast:
tato bAṣpaparikliṣṭaṃ pramArjantI svamAnanam |
śanairgadgadayA vAcA bhartAramidamabravIt
verses.translation: Then, wiping clean her face, which was bathed in tears, she spoke the following words slowly, in a stammering voice to her husband.

verses.devanagari:
किं मामसदृशं वाक्यमीदृशं श्रोत्रदारुणम् |
रूक्षं श्रावयसे वीर प्राकृतः प्राकृताम् इव
verses.iast:
kiṃ mAmasadṛśaṃ vAkyamIdṛśaṃ śrotradAruṇam |
rUkṣaṃ śrAvayase vIra prAkṛtaḥ prAkṛtAm iva
verses.translation: "O valiant Rama! Why are you speaking such harsh words, which are violent to hear for me, like a common man speaking to a common woman?"

glosses.meaning: are you causing me to hear

verses.devanagari:
न तथास्मि महाबाहो यथा त्वमवगच्छसि |
प्रत्ययं गच्छ मे स्वेन चारित्रेणैव ते शपे
verses.iast:
na tathAsmi mahAbAho yathA tvamavagacchasi |
pratyayaṃ gaccha me svena cAritreṇaiva te śape
verses.translation: "O the long-armed one! I am not the one in the way you understand me. Have a faith in me. I swear to you by my own character."

verses.devanagari:
पृथक्स्त्रीणां प्रचारेण जातिं त्वं परिशङ्कसे |
परित्यजेमां शङ्कां तु यदि तेऽहं परीक्षिता
verses.iast:
pṛthakstrIṇAṃ pracAreṇa jAtiṃ tvaṃ pariśañkase |
parityajemAṃ śañkAṃ tu yadi te'haṃ parIkṣitA
verses.translation: "By the conduct of vulgar woman you distrust the entire race of women. Give up this doubt, if I have been actually tested (and found trustworthy) by you."

glosses.meaning: have been actually tested (and found trustworthy)

verses.devanagari:
यद्यहं गात्रसंस्पर्शं गतास्मि विवशा प्रभो |
कामकारो न मे तत्र दैवं तत्रापराध्यति
verses.iast:
yadyahaṃ gAtrasaṃsparśaṃ gatAsmi vivaśA prabho |
kAmakAro na me tatra daivaṃ tatrAparAdhyati
verses.translation: "O lord! It was not my willfulness, when I came into contact with the person of Ravana. I was helpless. My adverse fate was to blame on that score."

verses.devanagari:
मदधीनं तु यत्तन्मे हृदयं त्वयि वर्तते |
पराधीनेषु गात्रेषु किं करिष्याम्यनीश्वरा
verses.iast:
madadhInaṃ tu yattanme hṛdayaṃ tvayi vartate |
parAdhIneṣu gAtreṣu kiṃ kariṣyAmyanIśvarA
verses.translation: "My heart, which was subservient to me, was abiding in you. What could I do, helpless as I was, with regard to my limbs which had fallen under the sway of another?"

glosses.meaning: which had fallen under the sway of another?

verses.devanagari:
सहसंवृद्धभावाच्च संसर्गेण च मानद |
यद्यहं ते न विज्ञाता हता तेनास्मि शाश्वतम्
verses.iast:
sahasaṃvṛddhabhAvAcca saṃsargeṇa ca mAnada |
yadyahaṃ te na viGYAtA hatA tenAsmi śAśvatam
verses.translation: "O bestower of honour! If I could not be fully known to you, in spite of our love having simultaneously grown and despite of our having lived together, I am ruined permanently by such ignorance."

glosses.meaning: If I could not be fully known to you
in spite of our love having simultaneously grown and despite of our having lived together

verses.devanagari:
प्रेषितस्ते यदा वीरो हनूमानवलोककः |
लङ्कास्थाहं त्वया वीर किं तदा न विसर्जिता
verses.iast:
preṣitaste yadA vIro hanUmAnavalokakaḥ |
lañkAsthAhaṃ tvayA vIra kiṃ tadA na visarjitA
verses.translation: "O king! Hanuma, the great hero, was sent by you as your search-agent. Why I, who was still in Lanka, was not abandoned then itself?"

verses.devanagari:
प्रत्यक्षं वानरेन्द्रस्य त्वद्वाक्यसमनन्तरम् |
त्वया सन्त्यक्तया वीर त्यक्तं स्याज्जीवितं मया
verses.iast:
pratyakṣaṃ vAnarendrasya tvadvAkyasamanantaram |
tvayA santyaktayA vIra tyaktaṃ syAjjIvitaṃ mayA
verses.translation: "O hero! Life would have been given up by me, when deserted by you; immediately on hearing the message (conveying your desertion) before the eyes of the monkey."

glosses.meaning: immediately on hearing the message (conveying your desertion)
before the eyes of this monkey.

verses.devanagari:
न वृथा ते श्रमोऽयं स्यात्संशये न्यस्य जीवितम् |
सुहृज्जनपरिक्लेशो न चायं निष्फलस्तव
verses.iast:
na vṛthA te śramo'yaṃ syAtsaṃśaye nyasya jIvitam |
suhṛjjanaparikleśo na cAyaṃ niṣphalastava
verses.translation: "This wasteful endeavour (in the form of crossing over to Lanka and waging war against the mighty Ravana, keeping your life in jeopardy), would not have been there, nor would have your friends been put to such fruitless hardship."

glosses.meaning: would have your friends have been put to such fruitless hardship.

verses.devanagari:
त्वया तु नरशार्दूल क्रोधमेवानुवर्तता |
लघुनेव मनुष्येण स्त्रीत्वमेव पुरस्कृतम्
verses.iast:
tvayA tu naraśArdUla krodhamevAnuvartatA |
laghuneva manuṣyeṇa strItvameva puraskṛtam
verses.translation: "O excellent king! You, however, like a feeble man, gave priority to womanliness, conforming yourself to just an emotion of anger."

glosses.meaning: to just an emotion of anger.

verses.devanagari:
अपदेशेन जनकान्नोत्पत्तिर्वसुधातलात् |
मम वृत्तं च वृत्तज्ञ बहु ते न पुरस्कृतम्
verses.iast:
apadeśena janakAnnotpattirvasudhAtalAt |
mama vṛttaṃ ca vṛttaGYa bahu te na puraskṛtam
verses.translation: "O knower of virtuous conduct! My birth was from Janaka in disguise; but was actually from the earth. My sacred birth of such a high degree, was not honoured by you."

glosses.meaning: but was actually from the earth

verses.devanagari:
न प्रमाणीकृतः पाणिर्बाल्ये बालेन पीडितः |
मम भक्तिश्च शीलं च सर्वं ते पृष्ठतः कृतम्
verses.iast:
na pramAṇIkṛtaḥ pAṇirbAlye bAlena pIḍitaḥ |
mama bhaktiśca śIlaṃ ca sarvaṃ te pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtam
verses.translation: "My hand taken (by you as a bride) in our childhood was not duly recognized by you. My devotion, my chastity and all have been ignored by you."

verses.devanagari:
इति ब्रुवन्ती रुदती बाष्पगद्गदभाषिणी |
उवाच लक्ष्मणं सीता दीनं ध्यानपरायणम्
verses.iast:
iti bruvantī rudatī bāṣpagadgadabhāṣiṇī |
uvāca lakṣmaṇaṃ sītā dīnaṃ dhyānaparāyaṇam
verses.translation: Seetha, thus speaking, weeping and stammering with tears, said to Lakshmana, who was sad and engaged in thoughtfulness (as follows):

verses.devanagari:
चितां मे कुरु सौमित्रे व्यसनस्यास्य भेषजम् |
मिथ्यापवादोपहता नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे
verses.iast:
citāṃ me kuru saumitre vyasanasyāsya bheṣajam |
mithyāpavādopahatā nāhaṃ jīvitumutsahe
verses.translation: "O Lakshmana! Create a pile of fire, for me, which is a remedy for this disaster. I no longer wish to survive, smitten as am with false blames."

glosses.meaning: smitten as I am with false blames

verses.devanagari:
अप्रीतेन गुणैर्भर्त्रा त्यक्ता या जनसंसदि |
या क्षमा मे गतिर्गन्तुं प्रवेक्ष्ये हव्यवाहनम्
verses.iast:
aprītena guṇairbhartrā tyaktā yā janasaṃsadi |
yā kṣamā me gatirgantuṃ pravekṣye havyavāhanam
verses.translation: "I will enter a fire, to obtain the only course appropriate for me, who has been abandoned amidst an assembly of men, by my husband who was not satisfied with my traits."

glosses.meaning: who has been jana samsadi = amidst an assembly of men

verses.devanagari:
एवं ब्रुवाणा रुदती बाष्पगद्गदभाषिणी |
अब्रवील्लक्ष्मणं सीता दीनं ध्यानपरं स्थितम्
verses.iast:
evaṃ bruvAṇA rudatI bAṣpagadgadabhAṣiṇI |
abravIllakṣmaṇaṃ sItA dInaṃ dhyAnaparaṃ sthitam
verses.translation: Hearing the words of Seetha, Lakshmana, the destroyer of enemy warriors, giving way to wrath, looked towards Rama.

verses.devanagari:
स विज्ञाय मनश्छन्दं रामस्याकारसूचितम् |
चितां चकार सौमित्रिर्मते रामस्य वीर्यवान्
verses.iast:
sa viGYAya manaśchandaṃ rAmasyAkArasUcitam |
citAṃ cakAra saumitrirmate rAmasya vIryavAn
verses.translation: Understanding the inclination of the mind of Rama, hinted by the expression in his face, that valiant Lakshmana prepared a pyre, in deference to the wishes of Rama.

glosses.meaning: hinted by the expression in his face
in deference to the wishes of Rama's.

verses.devanagari:
न हि रामं तदा कश्चित्कालान्तकयमोपमम् |
अनुनेतुमथो वक्तुं द्रष्टुं वा प्यशकत्सुहृत्
verses.iast:
na hi rāmaṃ tadā kaścitkālāntakayamopamam |
anunetumatho vaktuṃ draṣṭuṃ vā pyaśakatsuhṛt
verses.translation: No one near and dear was indeed able to cajole on that occasion or to speak or even to look upon Rama, who appeared like Yama the lord of death at the time of dissolution of the world.

glosses.meaning: who appeared like Yama the lord of death at the time of dissolution of the world.

verses.devanagari:
अधोमुखं ततो रामं शनैः कृत्वा प्रदक्षिणम् |
उपासर्पत वैदेही दीप्यमानं हुताशनम्
verses.iast:
adhomukhaṃ tato rAmaṃ śanaiḥ kṛtvA pradakṣiṇam |
upAsarpata vaidehI dIpyamAnaṃ hutAśanam
verses.translation: Thereupon, Seetha, after doing circumambulation to Rama, who was standing with his head bent low, proceeded towards the blazing fire.

glosses.meaning: standing with his head bent low Rama

verses.devanagari:
प्रणम्य देवताभ्यश्च ब्राह्मणेभ्यश्च मैथिली |
बद्धाञ्जलिपुटा चेदमुवाचाग्निसमीपतः
verses.iast:
praṇamya devatAbhyaśca brAhmaṇebhyaśca maithilI |
baddhAñjalipuṭA cedamuvAcAgnisamIpataḥ
verses.translation: Having offered salutation to gods and brahmins as also having joined her palms in the vicinity of the fire, Seetha spoke the following words:

glosses.meaning: as also having joined her palms
in the vicinity of the fire

verses.devanagari:
यथा मे हृदयं नित्यं नापसर्पति राघवात् |
तथा लोकस्य साक्षी मां सर्वतः पातु पावकः
verses.iast:
yathA me hṛdayaṃ nityaṃ nApasarpati rAghavAt |
tathA lokasya sAkṣI mAṃ sarvataḥ pAtu pAvakaḥ
verses.translation: "As my heart never moves off from Rama, so let the fire-god, the witness of the world, protect me from all sides."

verses.devanagari:
यथा मां शुद्धचरितां दुष्टां जानाति राघवः |
तथा लोकस्य साक्षी मां सर्वतः पातु पावकः
verses.iast:
yathā māṃ śuddhacaritāṃ duṣṭāṃ jānāti rāghavaḥ |
tathā lokasya sākṣī māṃ sarvataḥ pātu pāvakaḥ
verses.translation: "As Rama apprehends me, though of unimpeachable conduct, to be spoilt, let the fire-god the witness of the world protect me from all sides."

verses.devanagari:
कर्मणा मनसा वाचा यथा नातिचराम्यहम् |
राघवं सर्वधर्मज्ञं तथा मां पातु पावकः
verses.iast:
karmaṇā manasā vācā yathā nāticarāmyaham |
rāghavaṃ sarvadharmajJṇaṃ tathā māṃ pātu pāvakaḥ
verses.translation: "As I have never been unfaithful in act, thought and speech to Rama, who knows all the virtues, so let the fire-god protect me."

verses.devanagari:
आदित्योभवान् वायुर्दिशश्चन्द्रस्तथैव च |
अहश्चापि तथा सन्ध्ये रात्रिश्च पृथिवी तथा
यथान्येऽपि विजानन्ति तथा चारित्रसंयुताम् |
verses.iast:
ādityobhavān vāyurdiśaścandrastathaiva ca |
ahaścāpi tathā sandhye rātriśca pṛthivī tathā
yathānye'pi vijānanti tathā cāritrasaṃyutām |
verses.translation: "Since the adorable sun-god, wind-god, the four quarters and even so the moon-god, as also the deity presiding over the day-time and the twilights and the night and the earth and even others know me to be endowed with good conduct, so let the fire-god protect me."

glosses.meaning: as also the deity presiding over the day-time
to be endowed with good conduct

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्त्वा तु वैदेही परिक्रम्य हुताशनम्
विवेश ज्वलनं दीप्तं निःसङ्गेनान्तरात्मना |
verses.iast:
evamuktvA tu vaidehI parikramya hutAśanam
viveśa jvalanaṃ dIptaṃ niḥsañgenAntarAtmanA |
verses.translation: Thus speaking, Seetha walking around the fire-god, with her mind free from hesitation, entered the blazing fire.

verses.devanagari:
जनः स सुमहांस्तत्र बालवृद्धसमाकुलः
ददर्श मैथिलीं तत्र प्रविशन्तीं हुताशनम् |
verses.iast:
janaḥ sa sumahAṃstatra bAlavṛddhasamAkulaḥ
dadarśa maithilIṃ tatra praviśantIṃ hutAśanam |
verses.translation: A large gathering of men including children and elders, saw the shining Seetha having entered the fire there.

verses.devanagari:
सा तप्तनवहेमाभा तप्तकाञ्चनभूषणा
पपात ज्वलनं दीप्तं सर्वलोकस्य संनिधौ |
verses.iast:
sā taptanavahemābhā taptakāJṇcanabhūṣaṇā
papāta jvalanaṃ dīptaṃ sarvalokasya saṃnidhau |
verses.translation: That Seetha, with the shining of fresh refined gold and decked with ornaments of refined gold, plunged into the blazing fire, in the presence of all people.

glosses.meaning: having a shining of fresh refined gold
and decked with ornaments of refined gold
in the presence of all people.

verses.devanagari:
ददृशुस्तां विशालाक्षीं पतन्तीं हव्यवाहनम्
सीतां सर्वाणि रूपाणि रुक्मवेदिनिभां तदा |
verses.iast:
dadṛśustāṃ viśālākṣīṃ patantīṃ havyavāhanam
sītāṃ sarvāṇi rūpāṇi rukmavedinibhāṃ tadā |
verses.translation: All the living beings saw then that wide-eyed Seetha, who looked like a golden altar, plunging into the fire.

glosses.meaning: and looking like a sacrificial altar made of gold

verses.devanagari:
ददृशुस्तां महाभागां प्रविशन्तीं हुताशनम्
सीतां कृत्स्नास्त्रयो लोकाः पुण्यामाज्याहुतीमिव |
verses.iast:
dadṛśustāṃ mahābhāgāṃ praviśantīṃ hutāśanam
sītāṃ kṛtsnāstrayo lokāḥ puṇyāmājyāhutīmiva |
verses.translation: The sages, gods, and the Gandharvas saw that illustrious Seetha entering deep into the fire as a sacred oblation of clarified butter.

glosses.meaning: as a sacred oblation of clarified butter.

verses.devanagari:
प्रचुक्रुशुः स्त्रियः सर्वास्तां दृष्ट्वा हव्यवाहने
पतन्तीं संस्कृतां मन्रैर्वसोर्धारामिवाध्वरे |
verses.iast:
pracukruśuḥ striyaḥ sarvāstāṃ dṛṣṭvā havyavāhane
patantīṃ saṃskṛtāṃ manrairvasordhārāmivādhvare |
verses.translation: All the women (who were present there) screamed on seeing her, rushing into the fire, like a gush of clarified butter plunging into the sacrificial fire, duly consecrated by Vedic hymns.

verses.devanagari:
ददृशुस्तां त्रयो लोका देवगन्धर्वदाननाः
शप्तां पतन्तीं निरये त्रिदिवाद्देवतामिव |
verses.iast:
dadṛśustāṃ trayo lokā devagandharvadānanāḥ
śaptāṃ patantīṃ niraye tridivāddevatāmiva |
verses.translation: The denizens of the entire three worlds including the gods, Gandharvas and demons, beheld her falling into the fire, like a goddess, subjected to a curse, falling from heaven to hell.

verses.devanagari:
तस्यामग्निं विशन्त्यां तु हाहेति विपुलः स्वनः
रक्षसां वानराणां च सम्बभूवाद्भुतोपमः |
verses.iast:
tasyAmagniṃ viśantyAṃ tu hAheti vipulaḥ svanaḥ
rakṣasAṃ vAnarAṇAṃ ca sambabhUvAdbhutopamaḥ |
verses.translation: While she was entering deeply into the fire, a loud sound, which appeared strange, uttering 'Alas, Alas' rose both from the demons and the monkeys alike.

glosses.meaning: from both the demons and the monkeys alike.
